description: Small deterministic smoke corpus for exercising Ensemble lexical/vector/hybrid retrieval. These judgments are fixture-specific and are not a production relevance benchmark.

documents.title: Source lifecycle and generation recovery
documents.content: Source lifecycle protects indexed content across revisions. Tombstones hide deleted sources, generation rebuilds copy source records, reconciliation catches writes during a build, and interrupted cutover recovery keeps the write fence fail-closed. Permanent reclamation removes source-owned documents, vectors, knowledge, and graph edges only after safe recovery.

documents.title: Thompson sampling and model selection
documents.content: Thompson sampling selects models from Beta posteriors. Alpha equals successes plus one and beta equals failures plus one. Cost-aware filtering excludes models above the per-call cost limit, while untested models remain eligible. Selection is sampled rather than choosing the posterior mean.

documents.title: Vector collections and embedding similarity
documents.content: Vector collections store embedding vectors with a model identity and fixed dimensions. Similarity queries compare query embeddings with stored vectors using cosine or dot-product scores. An exact scan is not an approximate-nearest-neighbor index, and queries must use the same embedding model as the collection.

documents.title: Chunking profiles and boundaries
documents.content: Chunking profiles define chunk size, overlap, boundaries, and metadata. A preview shows the resulting chunk boundaries without persisting records. Ingestion stores the selected profile and chunk provenance so later retrieval can explain where each chunk came from.

documents.title: Pipeline execution traces and inspection
documents.content: Pipeline execution traces record ingestion and retrieval stages, status, duration, warnings, and stable identifiers. The Pipeline Inspector distinguishes actual persisted execution traces from independent diagnostic previews. A skipped or unavailable stage must not be shown as successfully executed.
